app.title: Pactaris
app.description: Consensual dynamics, built around privacy and choice.
foundation.title: Instance foundation
foundation.description: This development build verifies the instance runtime. Household workflows and sign-in are not available yet.
foundation.offline: The instance could not be reached. Try again when the connection is restored.
foundation.notEnabled: Sign-in is not enabled in this foundation checkpoint.
cli.help: Usage: install.sh|update.sh|status.sh|resume.sh --component identity|instance|gateway --root PATH [--config FILE] [--repository URL --revision FULL_SHA] [--apply]. Without --apply, install/update/resume only show a plan. See docs/DEVELOPMENT.md for prerequisites and limits.
cli.arguments: Invalid command arguments. Use --help for usage.
cli.preflight: A required prerequisite or configuration check failed ({check}).
cli.exists: This component is already installed; use update.sh.
cli.locked: Another operation is already running for this component.
cli.failed: The operation failed. The existing configuration and data were preserved. Check the component service logs.
cli.plan: Installation/update plan only; no services or persistent files were changed.
cli.installed: The component was activated and passed its local health check.
cli.recovery: The previous application release was restored. Database rollback is not performed automatically.
cli.failedRecovery: Activation and automatic application recovery failed. Operator intervention is required; configuration and data were retained.
cli.command: Running {tool}; command arguments and child output are kept private.
cli.commandFailed: Command {tool} failed ({code}); configuration and data were retained.
cli.resuming: Resuming the staged first installation of {component} at {revision}; existing configuration and secrets are preserved.
cli.interrupted: Operation interrupted; configuration and data were retained. Use resume.sh for a staged first installation; do not delete volumes or secrets.
cli.incomplete: A staged installation exists without a successful completion record. Use resume.sh with the original full release SHA; preserve configuration, secrets and volumes.
cli.commandLog: Protected command diagnostics were saved to {path}.
errors.request: The request could not be accepted.
errors.rateLimited: Too many sign-in attempts. Try again in a few minutes.
errors.loginUnavailable: Sign-in is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
errors.loginFailed: Sign-in could not be completed. Start a new sign-in attempt.
portal.title: Your dynamics
portal.signInDescription: Sign in to see the dynamics you belong to.
portal.notFound: This dynamic is unavailable or you no longer have access.
portal.partial: Some dynamics could not be checked. Please try again later.
portal.emptyDescription: Create a dynamic to begin. Invitations will be available in a later release.
cli.loginPlan: Prepare the existing local Identity/Instance installation for the gateway at {publicOrigin}; no changes were applied.
cli.loginPrepared: Login preparation completed for {publicOrigin}. Gateway configuration: {path}. Install/update the runtimes and configure public ingress before testing sign-in.
cli.updateHelp: Run update.sh as root to fetch main and update installed components. Options: --check (plan only), --root PATH, --component gateway|instance|identity, --revision FULL_SHA, --repository URL. --apply is accepted for compatibility; applying is now the default.
cli.updateRoot: Run the updater as root so it can read protected deployment state and perform backups.
cli.updateFetching: Fetching Pactaris source; installed configuration and data are preserved.
cli.updateSelected: Selected source revision {revision}; all components use this exact revision.
cli.updateState: Installed state for {component} is invalid or its release is missing; no automatic reset is performed.
cli.updateSource: The requested source revision or staged updater could not be verified.
cli.updateIdentityReview: The pinned Identity provider images changed. A reviewed provider-upgrade procedure is required; no component updates were started.
cli.updateStopped: An update step failed ({code}); later components were not updated. Earlier successful component updates remain active.
cli.updateUnchanged: No deployment change is needed for {component}.
cli.updateChecked: Update plan checked for {revision}; no services or application data were changed.
cli.updateComplete: Installed components are healthy after the update to {revision}; unchanged Identity deployments retain their own revision.
cli.updateArchived: An inactive staged update was preserved at {path}; retrying with a clean release directory.
cli.updatePrerequisite: Protected migration/backup credentials are missing or unsafe for {component}. Complete the documented deployment preparation before updating; existing data was retained.
errors.commandConflict: This operation conflicts with an earlier request. Refresh before trying again.
onboarding.createDescription: Create a private space for your agreed dynamic. Creating it does not accept any relationship agreement or assign anyone a dynamic role.
onboarding.name: Dynamic name
onboarding.createPending: A registration may still be in progress. Retry with the same name to resume it. Completed registrations appear in your dynamics list.
onboarding.leaveConfirm: Leaving ends your access to this dynamic. If you are its last owner, the remaining group is paused. If nobody remains, the dynamic closes. Records are not deleted.
onboarding.leavePending: Your departure has not yet been confirmed. Retry this request to check and finish it.
onboarding.limit: The creation limit for this installation has been reached. Pending registrations also count. You can still leave a dynamic.
onboarding.noInstance: Registration is temporarily unavailable. Please try again later.
onboarding.closed: This registration has ended. Refresh your dynamics before starting another.
onboarding.unknown: The result could not be confirmed. Retry the same request; it may already have been saved.
cli.updateRegistry: Registering the co-located Instance using its protected local configuration.
cli.updateRegistryPlan: The co-located Instance will be registered after successful component updates.
cli.updateRegistrySeparate: Separate backend CAs detected; existing registry data is preserved and explicit fleet enrollment is required.
invitations.title: Invitations
invitations.createDescription: Invite someone to join as a participant. Pending invitations reserve a place for 48 hours.
invitations.shareDescription: Copy and share this private link with the intended recipient. Keep the link: it cannot be recovered after a reload. You can revoke an invitation and create a replacement.
invitations.copyManual: Select and copy the link manually.
invitations.invalidLink: This invitation link is incomplete. Open the original link again.
invitations.signInThenReopen: Sign in with the invited verified email, then reopen the original invitation link. Joining is never automatic.
invitations.noConsent: Joining does not accept a relationship, dynamic role or agreement. Those require separate choices. You can leave the dynamic.
invitations.pending: Your response is being confirmed. Retry the same response to check its outcome.
invitations.left: That earlier membership has ended. A new invitation is required to join again.
invitations.unknownCreate: The invitation outcome is unknown. Retry with the same email and request. After a reload, review existing invitations before creating a replacement.
invitations.unknownResponse: Your response could not be confirmed. Retry to check the same request.
invitations.invalid: Check the invitation details and try again.
invitations.denied: This invitation is unavailable for this account.
invitations.conflict: This invitation has changed, expired or already been handled. Ask the sender for a new invitation.
invitations.capacity: There are no unreserved member places available. Review pending invitations or the member limit.
invitations.proof: A recent verified email assertion is required from this sign-in. Sign in again, then reopen the original link.
invitations.unavailable: Invitations are temporarily unavailable. Please try again.
members.title: Members and ownership
members.description: Technical permissions are separate from dynamic roles and relationship agreements.
members.name: Your name in this dynamic
members.nameDescription: Optional. This name is visible to current members of this dynamic. Leave it empty to show your membership ID.
members.removeDescription: This member will lose access immediately. Their pending invitations and ownership offers will be invalidated. Rejoining requires a new invitation and membership.
members.transferDescription: Ownership changes only after explicit acceptance. The recipient becomes an owner and the sender becomes a participant. Other owners remain owners. This changes administration, not relationship consent, billing or anyone's pause. An offer expires after 24 hours. You can still leave without waiting for acceptance.
members.confirmed: The operation was confirmed. The refreshed member list shows current permissions.
members.unknown: The outcome is not yet confirmed. Retry the same request or refresh to check its receipt.
members.retryDescription: Keep this page open to retry the original request. Leaving the dynamic remains available.
members.otherPending: An earlier operation is awaiting confirmation. Background receipt checks do not repeat the change.
members.invalid: Check the member details and try again.
members.denied: This membership or operation is unavailable for this account.
members.conflict: Membership or ownership has changed. Refresh the list before trying again.
members.reauthenticate: Sign in again before removing a member or offering/accepting ownership, then return to this dynamic.
members.unavailable: Member administration is temporarily unavailable. Please try again.
relationships.title: Relationships and contextual roles
relationships.description: Only the named participants can view a relationship, including its proposals and history. Household administration and role labels do not grant access or authority.
relationships.safetyNotice: Relationship acceptance records agreement to this description only. It does not authorize play, tasks or consequences, replace ongoing consent, or clear a pause or stop.
relationships.invalid: Check the relationship details and try again. A proposal supports 2–8 participants and up to 8 role assignments within the request size limit.
relationships.denied: This relationship or household is unavailable to your current membership.
relationships.conflict: This request no longer matches the relationship state. Refresh and review it again.
relationships.unavailable: Relationships are temporarily unavailable. No action is confirmed until the server acknowledges it.
relationships.membershipEnded: Ended because a participant left or was removed. Rejoining does not restore this relationship.
relationships.label: Relationship name or type
relationships.selfIncluded: You are included in your proposal. Select the other participants; no connections are inferred between them.
relationships.rolesDescription: Use your own labels. Assign several roles to a person, with an optional specific counterpart. These labels never grant application permissions.
relationships.proposalNotice: Submitting creates a proposal. Each participant, including you, must separately accept the exact description and assignments. Changes require a new proposal; existing acceptance is never copied.
relationships.empty: No relationships on this page. Only your own relationships are shown.
relationships.acceptNotice: Review all named participants, role assignments and the description above. This accepts only your own participation in this immutable proposal.
relationships.endNotice: Your decision ends this proposal or relationship for the whole group. No other participant can override it. A new proposal requires fresh acceptance from everyone.
relationships.confirmed: The server confirmed your request. Refresh to see the current relationship state.
relationships.unknown: The outcome is not confirmed. Refresh and retry the same request to resolve it; do not assume it failed.
relationships.retryDescription: The pending request is kept in this page only. Retrying uses the same operation ID and details, so an acknowledged action is not repeated. Leaving this page discards the local retry details.
consent.ackNotice: Pause, stop and withdrawal take effect only after server acknowledgement. These controls do not provide emergency delivery or work offline. A previously prepared safety connection can restrict activity for up to five minutes during a central account-database outage; the gateway and Instance must still be reachable.
consent.householdActive: The household is active. Individual consent and pauses still apply.
consent.householdPaused: The household is paused. Protected activity is blocked.
consent.selfActive: Your personal pause is clear. This is not consent to an activity.
consent.quorum: Every current member must explicitly agree to household re-entry for this stop version. At least one technical owner is required. Re-entry never clears personal or relationship pauses or renews consent.
consent.confirmed: The server acknowledged this request. Refresh for current state; a previous acceptance or resume acknowledgement does not override a later stop or withdrawal.
consent.unknown: The outcome is unconfirmed. Refresh and retry the exact request while its authorization remains valid. Do not assume failure or success. You can still request a new pause or stop.
consent.retryNotice: Retry details are kept only in this page. Discarding them does not cancel a request that may already have reached the server. An expired safety connection cannot confirm an old request; read the current state after reconnecting.
consent.invalid: Check the consent or safety request and try again.
consent.denied: The current membership, agreement or safety connection is unavailable.
consent.conflict: The agreement, limits or safety version changed. Refresh and review again.
consent.unavailable: Consent and safety could not be confirmed. The server may be unreachable; no offline success is implied.
consent.privateNotice: Only you can read or edit these fields through the app. They are not automatically copied into shared agreements. Changing them invalidates your previous acceptances. Structured activity blocks are enforced; free text is not interpreted automatically.
consent.blockedActivities: Block these activity categories for me
consent.notRealWorld: Recorded acceptance cannot prove real-world consent. A relationship never implies consent to a session, protocol or activity. Text limits cannot automatically validate arbitrary task wording; ongoing communication and consent are still required.
consent.pauseRelationship: Pause my involvement in this relationship
consent.sharedNotice: All relationship participants can read these terms. Each person must explicitly accept the exact version; creating or revising it does not accept for anyone. Revised terms immediately invalidate earlier acceptance for future protected activity.
consent.label: Agreement name
consent.revoked: This version was declined or withdrawn. New consent requires a new version.
consent.reviewNotice: Review the complete terms, participants and validity before accepting for yourself.
consent.accept: Accept this exact version for myself
consent.eligible: Current structured checks permit the task category for this agreement. This check does not execute work or guarantee consent at a later time.
consent.ineligible: The task category is blocked by the current agreement, limits, membership, expiry or safety state.
workspace.heading: Your dynamic workspace
workspace.welcome: Prepare your dynamic at your own pace. You can set up tasks and settings before inviting anyone.
workspace.ready: Your household is ready. No partner or relationship is needed to prepare your workspace.
workspace.privateTasks: These preparation tasks are private to you, including against household administrators. You can leave a task unassigned or explicitly assign it to yourself. Partner assignment and review will follow later.
workspace.emptyDescription: Create your first task or choose another status. No other member is needed.
workspace.dueAt: Optional due date and time (your device timezone)
workspace.timeZoneHelp: Use an IANA timezone, for example Europe/Amsterdam or UTC. Due dates are entered in your device timezone and displayed in the household timezone.
workspace.settingsDenied: Only a technical household owner or administrator can change these settings.
workspace.invalid: Check the task or household settings and try again.
workspace.denied: This workspace or task is unavailable to your current membership.
workspace.conflict: This task or setting changed. Refresh and review the current version.
workspace.capacity: The household has reached its active-task capacity. Existing tasks remain available; completing or archiving work releases capacity.
workspace.paused: Self-assignment or completion is blocked by the current pause, safety version or your task-category limit. You can still prepare an unassigned draft.
workspace.unavailable: The workspace is temporarily unavailable. No change is confirmed.
workspace.confirmed: The server confirmed your request. The workspace is refreshing.
workspace.unknown: The outcome is not confirmed. Refresh and retry the exact request to resolve it; do not assume it failed.
workspace.retryNotice: This request is kept only in this page. Retrying uses the same operation ID and details. Discarding local retry details does not cancel a request already received by the server.
library.guidanceDescription: Prepare guidance privately, even before inviting anybody. Publishing and exact-version acknowledgement are separate actions; neither creates an assignment or consent.
library.notesDescription: Keep personal notes and ideas, with optional explicit sharing. Other household administrators cannot read private notes.
library.household: All current and future household members
library.searchLabel: Search visible titles, categories and text
library.empty: No visible items on this page. Create your first private draft or change the search/filter.
library.draftNotice: Saving creates a new private draft version. Editing a published item withdraws it from other readers until you explicitly publish the new version. Earlier acknowledgements are not copied.
library.title: Title
library.sharingNotice: Drafts and archives are author-only. Selected members are exact current memberships; rejoining does not restore a selected share. Household publication also includes future members. No one is automatically acknowledged or assigned work.
library.chooseRecipients: Choose up to eight other current members
library.historical: Historical snapshot: only the author can browse earlier versions. This view cannot acknowledge or change the current version.
library.ackNotice: Acknowledgement means you have read this exact published version. It is not consent, agreement to perform an activity, permission, or acceptance for somebody else.
library.acknowledge: I have read this exact version
library.moreAcknowledgements: Showing the first twenty acknowledgements; further acknowledgement browsing will follow later.
library.publishNotice: Check the complete text and audience above. Publishing makes it available to that audience. It does not accept, acknowledge, assign or run anything for another person.
library.deleteNotice: This removes the note text and its saved versions from this Instance. It cannot be undone here. Previously viewed copies and backup retention are separate.
library.archiveNotice: Archiving withdraws current sharing and blocks new acknowledgement. Saved versions are retained. Restoring creates a private draft and does not automatically publish it.
library.invalid: Check the item, audience or search and try again. Text supports up to 2,000 characters within the total request size limit.
library.denied: This item, version or household is unavailable to your current membership.
library.conflict: The item changed or this action no longer matches its state. Refresh and review the current version.
library.unavailable: The library is temporarily unavailable. No change is confirmed.
library.confirmed: The server confirmed your request. The library is refreshing.
library.unknown: The outcome is unconfirmed. Refresh and retry the exact request; do not assume failure or success.
routines.description: Prepare your own routines before inviting anybody. Definitions and responses are private to your exact membership, including against household administrators. No automatic reminders, rewards or consequences run in this version.
routines.responseRecorded: Your response is recorded; this is not a judgement of its content.
routines.maximumNotice: A maximum is evaluated over the whole period. Being within it so far is not a completed-period result. No automatic consequence follows a missed or exceeded target.
routines.reflectionNotice: This is personal reflection, not consent to play or proof of wellbeing. Recording a check-in during a household/personal pause does not clear any pause or authorize activity.
routines.empty: No personal definitions on this page. You can create one without a partner or relationship.
routines.editNotice: Saving an edit creates a new configuration revision and returns it to draft. Earlier progress stays with its original targets and timezone. Activation/resume is explicit; no backlog is replayed.
routines.onceDate: Specific day in the definition timezone
routines.historical: Historical configuration: read its original progress or reverse a mistaken entry; new progress requires the current active revision.
routines.historyDay: View a day in the definition timezone
routines.record: Record personal progress or a response
routines.eventTimeNotice: Leave empty to use server time. For an earlier period, choose a matching past time within the last 90 days. Times are stored as instants and grouped in this definition’s timezone.
routines.chooseTime: Choose an explicit recorded time for the selected past or future period. Future registrations are not accepted.
routines.confirmRitual: Confirm that I performed this ritual
routines.reverseNotice: Keep the entry in history but exclude it from totals. This is available during breaks/pauses and does not execute a reward or other outcome.
routines.invalid: Check the routine, time or response. Use daily/weekly habits; rituals and check-ins also support a specific day. Registrations must match the response type and be no more than 90 days old.
routines.denied: This routine or entry is unavailable to your current membership.
routines.conflict: The routine changed, is not active, or already has a response in that period. Refresh; reverse a mistaken response before recording a replacement.
routines.paused: Activation or new habit/ritual progress is blocked by the current personal/household pause, safety version or activity-category limit. Private reflection check-ins do not resume activity.
routines.unavailable: Routines could not be loaded or changed. No result is confirmed.
routines.unknown: The outcome is unconfirmed. Refresh and retry the exact request; do not assume it failed.
routines.confirmed: The server confirmed your request. Refreshing personal progress.
cli.branchPlan: This feature branch is fully contained in the default branch and is a cleanup candidate.
cli.branchChanged: The branch advanced after inspection and was preserved.
cli.branchDeleted: The merged feature branch reference was removed using its expected revision.
cli.branchFailed: Branch cleanup could not finish. Use existing GitHub CLI write authentication on a development machine and review the current refs before retrying.
cli.branchHelp: Preview merged feature branches; use --apply to delete unchanged candidates.
catalog.title: Reward catalog
catalog.description: Prepare personal-private reward ideas before inviting anybody. Only your current membership can see these drafts, including against other household administrators. Saving a draft does not publish an offer, grant consent, issue points or execute a reward.
catalog.pointsHelp: Leave empty for no configured cost. Zero is an explicit zero-point proposal. Points are non-monetary planning values; no balance or redemption runs in this version.
catalog.empty: No reward drafts in this view. Prepare an idea whenever you choose.
catalog.historical: This is a saved earlier version, not the current draft. Its point cost does not change current content or create a transaction.
catalog.saved: The server confirmed your catalog change.
catalog.unknown: The result is unconfirmed. Retry the exact request before assuming it failed.
catalog.invalid: Check the reward draft fields and whole-number point cost.
catalog.denied: This private catalog item is not available to your current membership.
catalog.conflict: The catalog item changed or is archived. Refresh and review its current version.
catalog.unavailable: Your reward catalog could not be loaded or changed. No result is confirmed.
partner.title: Participant tasks
partner.description: Tasks are private to the creator and selected assignee. Use an individual offer or an explicitly adopted standing assignment policy.
partner.noOptions: No current task agreement is available. Review relationships, individual agreement acceptance, expiry, limits and pauses before offering work. Your private tasks remain available.
partner.dueHelp: Optional due time uses your device timezone. Overdue tasks never trigger an automatic consequence.
partner.shareConfirm: I confirm the selected recipient and exact agreement. Task content is shared only with this recipient. Direct assignment requires their adopted standing authority; they can always cancel work or withdraw authority.
partner.empty: No participant tasks in this view. Tasks appear only for their creator and assignee.
partner.fixedScope: The task scope, assignment policy and agreement version are fixed. To change them, cancel and create another task. Submissions and feedback are visible to both task participants.
partner.blocked: Progress is unavailable under the current agreement, consent, expiry, limits or pause state. You can still read, decline an offer or cancel active work.
partner.reopenNotice: Reopen this task under its original policy? Individual offers require acceptance again. Direct assignments return to the to-do list under current standing authority.
partner.confirmNotice: Confirm this task transition for the displayed version. Cancellation and declining do not require permission from the other participant.
partner.saved: The server confirmed your task change.
partner.unknown: The outcome is unconfirmed. Retry the exact request before assuming it failed.
partner.invalid: Check the task fields, participant and exact version.
partner.denied: This task or action is not available to your current membership.
partner.conflict: The task changed or this transition does not apply. Refresh and review its current state.
partner.paused: Current task consent, scope or safety state no longer permits progress. Refresh and review the agreement; declining or cancelling remains available.
partner.capacity: The household task or standing-authority capacity is reached. Finish or cancel permitted work, or revoke unused authority before adding more. Existing content is retained.
partner.unavailable: Participant tasks could not be loaded or changed. No result is confirmed.
partner.directPolicy: Standing direct assignment — no per-task acceptance
partner.policyHelp: Agree who may assign tasks to whom in this exact relationship agreement. The selected recipient must adopt a proposal before it grants authority. Either person can revoke it, pause or cancel work. Existing offers keep their decisions.
partner.proposePolicy: Propose standing authority for the selected recipient
partner.preferredPolicy: An adopted assignment policy is selected automatically for this recipient and agreement, preferring direct assignment. You can choose an individual offer or another adopted policy before creating the task.
partner.scheduleEnable: Plan dated occurrences under standing authority
partner.scheduleHelp: Generate up to seven days ahead. Missed availability times and nonexistent daylight-saving times are skipped. Repeated clock times occur once at standard time. Each series and each open occurrence uses active-task capacity.
partner.seriesBlocked: Generation blocked — review current scope and capacity before revising
partner.editScheduleHelp: Either participant can stop future generation. Revisions replace only future untouched assignments or offers; started work and history remain unchanged. Blocked series never resume automatically.
inbox.title: Task inbox
inbox.assigned: A task was assigned or offered
inbox.error: Could not load or update your task inbox.
partner.reversePointsConfirm: Reverse the points awarded for this task? This correction is permanent.
account.revokeOtherConfirm: Sign out your other Pactaris sessions and keep this session active?
account.sessionsRevoked: Other Pactaris sessions have been signed out.
mail.invitation.subject: An invitation to Pactaris
mail.invitation.body:
You have received a private Pactaris invitation. Open the link to review it. If you were not expecting this invitation, you can ignore this email.

{link}
invitations.emailEnabled: Pactaris will queue an email to this address. You can also share the link yourself.
invitations.delivery.sent: Email accepted by the mail server
invitations.delivery.failed: Email delivery failed. Share the link directly if it is still valid.
account.sessionsDescription: These are your active Pactaris sessions.
account.sessionsTruncated: Showing your current session and up to 49 other sessions. Sign out other sessions to close them all.
account.revokeOneConfirm: Sign out this other Pactaris session?
account.sessionRevoked: The selected session was signed out.
pwa.offlineDescription: Reconnect to view your households or send changes. Safety actions require a connection and server confirmation.
inbox.preferencesDescription: Choose which future task notices appear in your inbox for this household.
cli.brandMismatch: The Brand does not match the selected UUID and domain.
cli.brandVerify: Identity did not return the expected Brand settings. Review the protected backup.
cli.brandPlan: Brand preview for {domain}. Fields to change: {fields}.
cli.brandFailed: The Identity Brand request could not be completed.
cli.brandBackupRequired: Provide a new backup path with --backup before applying.
cli.brandTerminalRequired: Run from an interactive terminal to enter the API token privately.
account.presentationDescription: Choose a formatting locale such as en-GB and a personal time zone such as Europe/Amsterdam. Household schedules use the household time zone.
account.presentationInvalid: Enter a supported locale and an IANA time zone.
cli.backupPlan: Database backup preview for {component}. Use --apply to create a checkpoint.
cli.backupEmpty: The database dump was empty. The checkpoint is incomplete.
cli.monitorFailed: The local health report could not be collected.
account.verifyEmail: Verify your email address with your sign-in provider, then return to Pactaris and sign in again.
cli.publicSmoke: Public gateway and Identity smoke check results.
cli.publicSmokeInvalid: Provide the public HTTPS application origin and the exact HTTPS OIDC issuer.
